description: Upcoming stand-up / comedy shows. Filter by city slug (from list_cities), a window (today, weekend, upcoming = next 60 days) or an explicit date_from/date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, max 92 days), and optionally a venue slug. Dates are Mexico City time.

city.description: City slug, e.g. cdmx, monterrey, guadalajara.
